g.text: 29b · Keyframe vision analysis and speech transcription
Download keyframe image bytes and verify SHA256 checksum
Analyze visual frame content (Scene captions, OCR, objects)
Return structured frame description, objects, and OCR
Transcribe segmented audio via Whisper speech model
Bypass speech ASR; synthesize transcript from visual OCR and author metadata
Extract unified Reel summary, keywords, and topics via LLM
Return extracted metadata; creator fields remain primary
Checkpoint extracted metadata and transcript sections
